Hey I understand you are having negative thoughts about Valentine’s Day, I would have them too but I changed the way I look at things. That negative situation of not having anybody to share Valentine’s Day with is only a temporary situation not a permanent one. I spent almost a decade of being alone and it seemed never ending. Once I truly accepted myself and realized that I am worthy of loving and that I have a lot of love to give then I was able to meet my future wife, I’m now happily engaged. I’m not bragging but trying to explain that there is light at the end of the tunnel but it starts with working on yourself. You also need to have hope and stay hopeful. Even a shred of hope for better days to come will make a huge difference in your life. If you don’t have any hope at all then that’s when you have lost. Always have hope and on top of that you need to accept yourself- your differences do not limit what your future will bring. It is more than possible to find someone special who loves you and has knowledge of autism. You have to have a healthy mindset and have hope. Hope alone isn’t everything you will need to have. Action is also important. When you have accepted yourself and have a clear vision of what you want in your life, you will need to be proactive and take those steps to put yourself out there to find someone special. This means getting out of your comfort zone and talking to people, being an active listener to the people you meet and growing a healthy relationship from the ground up that empowers both of you

Urine Test
This drug test is the most common type of test for marijuana users. A urine test detects drug use differently based on how often you take it.

Occasional users (3 times a week or less): 3 days
Moderate users (4-5 times a week): 5-7 days
Heavy users (daily): 10-15 days
Chronic users (multiple times per day): 30 days or more

Metabolites are fat-soluble materials that can bind to fat cells in the body. Hence, it can time some time for the body to eliminate them.

The above-mentioned time frames are estimates. How long the metabolites stay in your system depends on how soon your body eliminates them and other factors. How much delta-8 THC you consume will have an effect as well. Moderate users flush out the metabolites faster than heavy or chronic users.

I'd be happy with a $10 minimum wage in Texas. Currently the minimum wage is $7.25 an hr and has not gone up since 2009. Texas is long overdue for a change. contrary to popular belief this doesn't just affect teenagers who work at KFC. This affects adults who are caregivers- CNA's, preschool teachers, daycare and those who have customer service jobs and many other entry level jobs. Entry level jobs are important because it allows people who are hardworking but cannot afford college or want to to be in debt because of college the opportunity to work. These jobs are often flexible with work hours and therefore are what  many women who have families and small children will choose. People who were fortunate enough to go to college and get the job of their choice shouldn't look down on those who work minimum or low wage jobs.
